claims.statement: The Roblox outage began on October 28, 2021 and lasted approximately 73 hours until October 31, 2021.
claims.source: Roblox Corporation Official Return to Service Address (CEO David Baszucki, Nov 2, 2021)

claims.statement: Roblox had approximately 43.2 million to 50 million daily active users during October 2021.
claims.source: Roblox Corporation Q3 2021 Shareholder Letter & SEC Form 10-Q

claims.statement: Financial analysts estimated platform booking and advertising losses between $15M and $25M.
claims.source: Wall Street Journal / Bloomberg Market Intelligence Report (Nov 2021)

claims.statement: The internet attributed the crash to Chipotle offering 30,000 free burritos in their Halloween event.
claims.source: Chipotle Mexican Grill Press Release (Oct 2021) & Twitter Global Trends #RobloxDown

claims.statement: The root cause was a subtle concurrency bug in HashiCorp Consul causing thread contention under high cluster server counts.
claims.source: Roblox Engineering Technical Post-Mortem (Engineering VP Matt Brown, Jan 2022)

claims.statement: Over 50,000 backend servers required circular dependencies to be manually broken during restart.
